wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Parallel World AI Prediction Engine project overview. Explain the vision of building a collective intelligence mirror that maps reality through multi-agent simulation. Document the core concept of constructing high-fidelity parallel digital worlds with thousands of interacting agents having independent personalities and behavioral logic. Describe how users can dynamically inject variables through a 'God's-eye view' to forecast future trajectories. Include the project's mission to enable zero-risk policy testing and creative simulation exploration. Provide context about the OASIS multi-agent simulation platform foundation and the team's strategic support from Shanda Group.

wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the Document Ingestion Pipeline that transforms raw documents into structured text for knowledge graph construction. Address error handling for corrupted files, unsupported formats, and memory management during large document processing. Provide configuration options for text extraction parameters and quality thresholds.

Detail the dual-platform architecture supporting Twitter and Reddit simulations with platform-specific configurations. Describe the simulation data directory structure and file organization patterns. Document the simulation ID generation, directory management, and state serialization mechanisms. Provide examples of simulation creation, preparation workflows, and state monitoring patterns.

<blog>

# Parallel World: A Comprehensive AI Prediction Engine Overview

## Project Introduction

**Parallel World** is a cutting-edge AI prediction engine that leverages multi-agent technology to create high-fidelity digital replicas of real-world scenarios. The platform transforms seed information from various sources (breaking news, policy drafts, financial signals, literary works) into interactive digital worlds where thousands of autonomous agents with distinct personalities and behaviors evolve over time.

### Purpose Statement
Parallel World serves as a "digital sandbox" where users can rehearse future scenarios, test hypotheses, and make informed decisions by observing emergent behaviors in controlled environments.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Universal Prediction Engine**: Apply swarm intelligence across diverse domains including finance, politics, and entertainment
- **High-Fidelity Simulation**: Create realistic agent interactions with long-term memory and behavioral logic
- **Accessible Interface**: Provide intuitive tools for both technical and non-technical users
- **Real-World Impact**: Enable decision-making through scenario testing without real-world risks

### Target Audience
- **Decision Makers**: Government officials, business leaders, and policy analysts requiring scenario planning
- **Researchers**: Academics studying complex systems and emergent behavior
- **Content Creators**: Writers and storytellers exploring alternative narrative outcomes
- **Developers**: Technical users interested in multi-agent systems and AI simulation

## Technical Architecture

The Parallel World system follows a modern full-stack architecture with clear separation of concerns between frontend, backend, and data layers.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Interface] --> B[Vue.js Frontend]
    B --> C[Flask Backend API]
    C --> D[PostgreSQL + pgvector]
    C --> E[LLM Services]
    C --> F[File Processing]
    C --> G[Simulation Engine]
    
    H[OASIS Platform] --> G
    I[CAMEL AI] --> G
    
    J[External APIs] --> E
    K[Local Storage] --> F
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer (Vue.js)**
- Single-page application with reactive components
- Real-time data visualization and user interaction
- Responsive design supporting multiple device types

**Backend Layer (Flask)**
- RESTful API providing clean separation of concerns
- Asynchronous task management for long-running operations
- Modular service architecture for maintainability

**Data Layer**
- PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search capabilities
- Local file storage for document processing
- In-memory project state management for workflow persistence

### Design Patterns

The system implements several key architectural patterns:

- **Application Factory Pattern**: Flask application creation with configurable environments
- **Service Layer Pattern**: Clear separation between business logic and data access
- **Task Queue Pattern**: Background processing for graph building and simulation tasks
- **Repository Pattern**: Unified data access layer abstraction
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time polling for task status updates

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Backend Entry Point**
- [`backend/run.py`](backend/run.py): Application startup and configuration validation
- [`backend/app/__init__.py`](backend/app/__init__.py): Flask application factory with middleware registration
- [`backend/app/config.py`](backend/app/config.py): Centralized configuration management

**Frontend Entry Point**
- [`frontend/src/main.js`](frontend/src/main.js): Vue.js application bootstrap
- [`frontend/src/App.vue`](frontend/src/App.vue): Root component definition
- [`frontend/src/router/index.js`](frontend/src/router/index.js): Route configuration

### Core Modules

**Graph Construction Pipeline**
- [`backend/app/api/graph.py`](backend/app/api/graph.py): Primary API endpoints for project and graph management
- [`backend/app/services/graph_builder.py`](backend/app/services/graph_builder.py): Core graph building service
- [`backend/app/models/project.py`](backend/app/models/project.py): Project state management and persistence

**Simulation Framework**
- [`backend/app/services/simulation_manager.py`](backend/app/services/simulation_manager.py): Simulation orchestration
- [`backend/app/services/simulation_runner.py`](backend/app/services/simulation_runner.py): Individual simulation execution
- [`backend/app/services/report_agent.py`](backend/app/services/report_agent.py): Report generation and analysis

**Data Processing**
- [`backend/app/utils/file_parser.py`](backend/app/utils/file_parser.py): Multi-format document processing
- [`backend/app/utils/text_processor.py`](backend/app/utils/text_processor.py): Text preprocessing and chunking
- [`backend/app/services/entity_extractor.py`](backend/app/services/entity_extractor.py): Named entity recognition

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Management**
- [`backend/pyproject.toml`](backend/pyproject.toml): Python dependencies and project metadata
- [`frontend/package.json`](frontend/package.json): Frontend dependencies and build scripts
- [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml): Container orchestration and service dependencies
- [`Dockerfile`](Dockerfile): Multi-stage container build process

**Configuration Patterns**
- Centralized environment variable loading from `.env` files
- Runtime configuration validation with meaningful error messages
- Graceful fallback to default values for optional settings

### External Dependencies

**Core Framework Dependencies**
- **Flask 3.0+**: Web application framework with modern features
- **Vue.js 3.5+**: Progressive JavaScript framework for frontend
- **SQLAlchemy 2.0+**: ORM for database interactions
- **PostgreSQL + pgvector**: Advanced vector database for similarity search

**AI and Machine Learning**
- **OpenAI SDK**: Unified interface for various LLM providers
- **PyMuPDF**: PDF document processing capabilities
- **CAMEL AI/OASIS**: Multi-agent simulation platform integration

**Development and Build Tools**
- **uv**: Fast Python package installer and resolver
- **Vite**: Modern frontend build toolchain
- **Docker**: Containerization for consistent deployment

### Integration Points

**API Layer Architecture**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant API
    participant Service
    participant Database
    
    Client->>+API: HTTP Request
    API->>+Service: Business Logic Call
    Service->>+Database: Data Operations
    Database-->>-Service: Results
    Service-->>-API: Processed Data
    API-->>-Client: JSON Response
```

**Component Relationship Diagram**
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Frontend Components] --> B[API Layer]
    B --> C[Service Layer]
    C --> D[Data Layer]
    C --> E[LLM Integration]
    C --> F[File Processing]
    
    G[Project Manager] --> C
    H[Task Manager] --> C
    I[Graph Builder] --> C
    J[Simulation Runner] --> C
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Knowledge Graph Construction**
- Multi-document ingestion from PDF, Markdown, and text formats
- Automated ontology generation using LLM-powered analysis
- Semantic chunking and vector embedding for intelligent search
- Real-time graph visualization and exploration

**Multi-Agent Simulation Environment**
- Customizable agent personalities and behavioral patterns
- Dynamic environment configuration based on user requirements
- Parallel simulation across multiple platforms (Twitter, Reddit)
- Temporal memory management for realistic agent behavior

**Predictive Analytics**
- Scenario-based forecasting with confidence metrics
- Interactive report generation with actionable insights
- Comparative analysis of different intervention strategies
- Real-time simulation parameter adjustment

### Implementation Highlights

**Asynchronous Processing Pipeline**
- [`backend/app/api/graph.py`](backend/app/api/graph.py): Complete workflow orchestration
- [`backend/app/models/task.py`](backend/app/models/task.py): Task queue management
- [`backend/app/services/extraction_worker.py`](backend/app/services/extraction_worker.py): Parallel entity extraction

**Real-Time User Experience**
- [`frontend/src/views/MainView.vue`](frontend/src/views/MainView.vue): Interactive workflow interface
- [`frontend/src/components/GraphPanel.vue`](frontend/src/components/GraphPanel.vue): Dynamic graph visualization
- [`frontend/src/api/graph.js`](frontend/src/api/graph.js): Frontend-backend communication layer

**Advanced Visualization**
- [`frontend/src/components/Step1GraphBuild.vue`](frontend/src/components/Step1GraphBuild.vue): Multi-step workflow guidance
- [`frontend/src/components/SystemLog.vue`](frontend/src/components/SystemLog.vue): Real-time system monitoring
- [`frontend/src/components/StatusLine.vue`](frontend/src/components/StatusLine.vue): Progress tracking and status indicators

### Feature Architecture

**State Management Flow**
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Created: New Project
    Created --> OntologyGenerated: Ontology Generated
    OntologyGenerated --> GraphBuilding: Build Graph Started
    GraphBuilding --> GraphCompleted: Build Successful
    GraphBuilding --> Failed: Build Failed
    GraphCompleted --> SimulationReady: Ready for Simulation
    SimulationReady --> SimulationRunning: Simulation Started
    SimulationRunning --> ReportGenerated: Simulation Complete
    ReportGenerated --> InteractionMode: User Interaction
    InteractionMode --> [*]: Session Complete
```

**Data Processing Pipeline**
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Document Upload] --> B[File Parsing]
    B --> C[Text Preprocessing]
    C --> D[Chunk Generation]
    D --> E[LLM Analysis]
    E --> F[Entity Extraction]
    F --> G[Graph Construction]
    G --> H[Vector Embedding]
    H --> I[Semantic Search]
```

The Parallel World project represents a sophisticated integration of modern web technologies, AI capabilities, and multi-agent simulation frameworks. Its modular architecture supports both development flexibility and production scalability, while maintaining an intuitive user experience for complex predictive analytics workflows.

**Sources:**
- [run.py](backend/run.py)
- [__init__.py](backend/app/__init__.py)
- [config.py](backend/app/config.py)
- [graph.py](backend/app/api/graph.py)
- [project.py](backend/app/models/project.py)
- [graph_builder.py](backend/app/services/graph_builder.py)
- [main.js](frontend/src/main.js)
- [App.vue](frontend/src/App.vue)
- [index.js](frontend/src/router/index.js)
- [pyproject.toml](backend/pyproject.toml)
- [package.json](frontend/package.json)
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile)
- [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml)
- [README.md](README.md)

</blog>
